$comment: LEVEL 4 -- DILIM. Every line is the apo's: Lolo stopped at the water (Dagat's farewell),
so `speaker_default` is "apo" and every line says so as well.
She talks to herself, and what she says is what she sees. What Lola taught her about each
creature is in Lola's own hand now: her bestiary, found as she enters, opens at the creature's
page the first time she reaches it (DIARY.md; Kent, 2026-11-01: 'instead of the apo saying
lola said this lola said that'). So no line here says 'Lola said', and an arrival line is
what she sees, said once the book is put down. It never says what to draw.
⚠ NO LINE MAY NAME A DRAWABLE CLASS. Here the traps are horse (the tikbalang),
tree (the kapre's perch), sun (the morning), clock (the finale) and fan. The check is
word-boundary and case-insensitive, and run_level4_audit.gd runs it.
⚠ NOTHING STORY-SHAPED MID-ENCOUNTER. A lore line pauses the whole tree; once something
is hunting her, only `kind: hint` lines (the hint bar, which never stops play) are said.
The arrivals below are said on the way in, before anything has moved.
RESPAWN is a pool: LevelBase says one per knockout, in turn, through the hint bar.
WHAT IS NOT HERE YET: each later encounter's answered and after lines, the
finale's waves and the morning. They come with the encounters that say them -- an
unreachable line is an audit failure, not a placeholder.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Lola painted this one. She used to tell me what lived in these woods.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The manananggal. The tikbalang. She'd name them one by one, so I'd know them if I ever met one.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: I thought she was scaring me. She was teaching me.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Lolo stopped at the water. From here it is only me, and what she taught me.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: And the lamp is burning low already. I will have to fill it at the first clearing I come to.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The woods take the ones who stop paying attention.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The dark is only dark. It is what is in it I have to watch for.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: When the lamp goes out, I go back to where it was last lit.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: No more ink. The next clearing will give it back.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: A mound on the path, with things left all round it. A punso.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Tabi-tabi po. Excuse me -- I only need to pass.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: My foot -- it is swelling. I stood on it. It wears off if I keep going. It has to.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Something stirred in the mound. They remember the ones who ask.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Over, and not a crumb of it touched. Lola would still have asked.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: A clearing. Somewhere to make a **light** of my own, and fill the lamp before I go on.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There. Warm. The lamp drinks it up, and the dark steps back a little.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: These tracks go backwards.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It cannot bear being seen. Lola was right about that one.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Nothing behind me but rock, and nowhere for it to be. It gave up.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Gone. Lola would say it will be back for someone else, just not tonight.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: This is the same rock. I have passed it three times now.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The same rock again. Whichever way I go, it brings me back.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: To the far side, then. All the way, and no stopping.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It got there first. Back to the rock.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It took me for one of its own, and stepped aside.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It does not chase what it does not hunt. That was the trick.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Beat it. It will not forgive that -- but it keeps its word.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Smoke, and somebody up there smoking it.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Turned round in the smoke again. I am back where I came in.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: There it is. It was only sitting up there smoking, the whole time.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Down it comes, and off it goes. I did not have to be so hard on it.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Knocked clean out of its hand. It will not sit there smoking at anyone else tonight.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Somewhere to stop. The far side of the woods is the worst of it. Fill the lamp first.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Warm again. Whatever is past here, I will meet it with a full lamp.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: A baby crying, out here?

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: That was never a baby. In the light it was what it is.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: I kept to the path, and it could not come to me. It is still crying back there.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It cried like a child the whole time. Lola never told me what to do about that, and I wish she had.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Something big on the far side of the gap, laughing to itself.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It is laughing too hard to stand. Lola was right: nothing is stronger than a good laugh.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Over it, and it never even looked up. Some crossings you do not have to fight for.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Down it goes, still grinning. I hope it laughs about this one day.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Only half of her is up there.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Caught in the light, she cannot come back together. Off she goes, half of her and all.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Salt on what she left behind. She will not be whole again, not tonight and not ever.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Gone, for now. But the rest of her is still standing down there, waiting for her to come back.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: This is the clearing in the painting. They are all coming, are they not.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Then I only have to last until morning.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Morning. Lola named every one of them for me, one by one. I needed every one.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Wings over the trees. A blade on the ground will not reach them.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Tik... tik... It sounds far, so it is close. Ash shows it.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The woods again. Keep the lamp close.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Listen. Nothing yet.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Again. I know these woods better than they know me now.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Up the mountain from the sea. My clothes are still salty.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Good. They cannot stand salt.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Last time I mostly asked, and they mostly let me by.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Last time I mostly went round them. Quiet, and quick.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Last time I mostly fought my way through. I am not sure Lola would have.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The town at the foot of this mountain is called Los Baños, the baths, for the hot springs it keeps warm.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: People say Makiling has a keeper, Maria Makiling. Take from her forest without asking, they say, and you will not find the way down.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: From the lake, the mountain looks like a woman lying on her back. That is where the story of its keeper comes from.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: The forest on Makiling is kept for learning now. People come up to put a name to everything that grows in it.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It saw it. Lola's brush wants it surer.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It's learning my hand.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: {fact} Not what this needs. It needs something that can {needed}.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: {who} can {can}. This needs something that can {needed}.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: That won't do it. I need something that can {needed}.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Think. In the dark I need something that can {needed}.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Wrong one. Something that can {needed}.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Too rushed. Finish the lines.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It doesn't need to be big. It needs to be clear.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Fewer marks. One clean shape.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Slow down. Close the shapes.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Draw the part only it has.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: It looks like two things. Show which.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Close. Add what tells it apart.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Two things in one drawing. Pick one.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Nearly. One more line.

lines.speaker: apo
lines.text: Make the difference plain.

conversations.$comment: Played by LevelBase._run_conversation the first time she arrives. Steps point at hooks above.
